sampleProducts.descriptionHtml: Premium 240 GSM combed cotton oversized streetwear t-shirt with high-density DTF graphic print. Features dropped shoulders, ribbed crew collar, and relaxed silhouette.

Do not iron directly over the graphic print.
Do not use chlorine bleach.
